message: This is great. Partly because it allows me to eavesdrop on a conversation between Mike and Peter Elbow, just as if I was there. But also because it allows me to look at what I'm doing in a new way. Yesterday I decided we'd start with this interval training, in a class called "Ethics and Sports." The targeted students are student athletes, but we have a lot of non-sports playing athletes, such as a girl who races motocross. I told them if this is good enough for West Point, it's good enough for them too. This week, it's five minutes. Next week, 10. The week after 15. I'm not sure if we'll go further than that because of all we have to do, but it's now a regular part of class. Thanks for posting this Mike. This is what makes the internet great.
